topic: External Parts and Functions of Animals
key_concepts: Animals have common body parts: head, body, and legs.
The head holds the mouth, nose, ears, tongue, and teeth and is used for sensing.
The body is the biggest part and protects internal organs.
Legs are located below the body and enable animals to walk and run.
Tails are used for balance and communication.
Fur protects animals from cold and heat.
Wings are special forelimbs used by birds for flying.
A beak is used for picking up food.
Fish have gills for breathing, fins for swimming, and scales for protection.
Animals use special body parts for protection, movement, and getting food.
